question: Count orders by month in 2026.
gold_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) = 2026 GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
predicted_sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01' GROUP BY year, month ORDER BY year, month
raw_output:
SELECT 
  EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_date) AS year,
  EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_date) AS month,
  COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM 
  orders
WHERE 
  order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND order_date < '2027-01-01'
GROUP BY 
  year, month
ORDER BY 
  year, month;

question: Show suppliers with their product counts.
gold_sql: SELECT s.supplier_name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count FROM suppliers s JOIN products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.supplier_name ORDER BY product_count DESC
predicted_sql: SELECT suppliers.supplier_id, suppliers.supplier_name, COUNT(products.product_id) AS product_count FROM suppliers LEFT JOIN products ON suppliers.supplier_id = products.supplier_id GROUP BY suppliers.supplier_id, suppliers.supplier_name
raw_output:
SELECT 
  suppliers.supplier_id, 
  suppliers.supplier_name, 
  COUNT(products.product_id) AS product_count
FROM 
  suppliers
LEFT JOIN 
  products ON suppliers.supplier_id = products.supplier_id
GROUP BY 
  suppliers.supplier_id, 
  suppliers.supplier_name;

question: For every category, list its 4 best selling products.
gold_sql: WITH ranked AS ( SELECT p.category_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS revenue, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p.category_id ORDER BY SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) DESC ) AS rn FROM products p JOIN order_items oi ON oi.product_id = p.product_id GROUP BY p.category_id, p.product_id, p.product_name) SELECT category_id, product_name, revenue FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 4 ORDER BY category_id, revenue DESC
predicted_sql: SELECT c.category_id, c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS total_revenue FROM categories c JOIN products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id GROUP BY c.category_id, c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name ORDER BY c.category_id, total_revenue DESC LIMIT 4
raw_output:
SELECT 
  c.category_id,
  c.category_name,
  p.product_id,
  p.product_name,
  SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount_pct / 100)) AS total_revenue
FROM 
  categories c
JOIN 
  products p ON c.category_id = p.category_id
JOIN 
  order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
GROUP BY 
  c.category_id, c.category_name, p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY 
  c.category_id, 
  total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 4;

question: Show stock that needs reordering.
gold_sql: SELECT p.product_name, w.warehouse_name, i.quantity_on_hand, i.reorder_level FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id WHERE i.quantity_on_hand < i.reorder_level ORDER BY p.product_name

raw_output:
SELECT 
  i.inventory_id,
  i.product_id,
  i.warehouse_id,
  i.quantity_on_hand,
  i.reorder_level
FROM 
  inventory i
WHERE 
  i.quantity_on_hand <= i.reorder_level;

question: Which 9 warehouses hold the most valuable stock?
gold_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_name, SUM(i.quantity_on_hand * p.unit_price) AS stock_value FROM inventory i JOIN warehouses w ON w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id = i.product_id GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY stock_value DESC LIMIT 9
predicted_sql: SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, SUM(p.unit_price * i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock_value FROM inventory i JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id WHERE p.is_discontinued = FALSE GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name ORDER BY total_stock_value DESC LIMIT 9
raw_output:
SELECT w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name, SUM(p.unit_price * i.quantity_on_hand) AS total_stock_value
FROM inventory i
JOIN products p ON i.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN warehouses w ON i.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
WHERE p.is_discontinued = FALSE
GROUP BY w.warehouse_id, w.warehouse_name
ORDER BY total_stock_value DESC
LIMIT 9;
